[{"insert":"Goblet Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat

The goblet rear foot elevated split squat puts your back foot up on a bench so almost all the work lands on your front leg. Holding the weight at your chest keeps you tall and drives the load into that front quad. Go slow and keep the front heel down. Pair it with the Copenhagen plank to build the inner thigh, a spot that usually gets ignored.
"}]
